en.title: Congo's Ebola outbreak has recorded over 4,000 deaths as authorities struggle to contain the virus

stories.title: ‎Expat remittances up to SAR 13.5B in August; Saudi transfers reach SAR 5.8B

en.title: Expat remittances up to SAR 13.5B in August; Saudi transfers reach SAR 5.8B
en.summary: Expatriate remittances in Saudi Arabia increased 1% year-on-year to SAR 13.5 billion in August 2026, though they declined 6% compared to July. The first eight months of 2026 saw total remittances of around SAR 113 billion, up 1% from the same period in 2025.

stories.title: ‎Gold prices rise ahead of US jobs report

en.title: Gold prices rise ahead of US jobs report
en.summary: Gold prices increased as investors awaited the US September jobs report for guidance on Federal Reserve policy. The dollar index fell 0.20% to 101.92, with traders estimating a 28% chance of a rate hike this month but an 82% probability in December.
